_about: Muslim openings. Quranic portions match quran.com's simple (imlaei) text exactly (checked 24 Nov 2026). Meanings marked 'Sahih International' are that translation; others as supplied by the owner. verified=false until checked by a knowledgeable person.

items.title: Bismillah
items.meaning: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

items.title: Alhamdulillah
items.meaning: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds

items.title: Islamic Greeting
items.translit: As-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh
items.meaning: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings

items.title: Surah Ar-Rum (30:21)
items.text: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
items.meaning: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.

items.title: Surah Al-Furqan (25:74)
items.text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.

items.title: Surah An-Nisa (4:1)
items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ

items.title: Surah Al-Ahzab (33:70)
items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا

items.title: Surah An-Naba (78:8)
items.meaning: And We created you in pairs.

items.title: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:187)
items.text: هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ
items.meaning: They are a clothing for you and you are a clothing for them.

items.title: Wedding Blessing
items.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
items.translit: Barakallahu laka wa baraka alaika wa jama'a bainakuma fi khair.
items.meaning: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you and bring you together in goodness.

items.title: Wedding Dua
items.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمَا وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِمَا وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنَهُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
items.meaning: O Allah, bless them both and unite them in goodness.

items.title: Allah ke Fazl o Karam se
items.text: اللہ کے فضل و کرم سے
items.meaning: By the grace and kindness of Allah

items.title: Invitation to the Nikah
items.text: الحمدللہ، ہم آپ کو دعوتِ نکاح دیتے ہیں
items.meaning: Praise be to Allah, we invite you to the Nikah

items.title: On This Joyous Occasion
items.text: خوشی کے اس پُرمسرت موقع پر
items.meaning: On this joyous and happy occasion
